acceptance_criteria: A new explicit user approval is recorded before the formal spec is frozen and before create_run; no inferred approval event timestamp is used.
Resolved host Python is frozen Anaconda Python 3.13.5 with NumPy 2.1.3.
Exactly ten trajectories use tunnel=train and garage=validation with seeds 11/23/37/53/71 and test_id 0001.
Each trajectory has exactly 3000 finite synchronized frames, at least 50 m movement and exactly 600 samples at raw indices 0,5,...,2995.
Aggregate counts are 30000 raw and 6000 effective frames split 3000/3000 without deletion or reordering.
Each successful case passes ownership handoff and creates a new non-overwriting zstd-10 archive whose decompressed SHA-256 equals the original before raw removal.
Teacher queries, model inference, training/optimizer steps, C09 reads and C10 reads are zero.
baseline: V1R2 is the sealed governance-metadata failure: it was stopped before one trajectory completed because its frozen approval timestamp was later than run start. It contributed zero formal frames. V1R remains the sealed permission-failure baseline whose first trajectory proved the scientific collector contract.

Ten trajectory contracts/logs/shards/audits, ownership handoffs and verified non-overwriting archives.
Exact 30000/6000 manifest, split counts, summary, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

The original V1 collector, ten trajectories, frame selection and all scientific thresholds remain unchanged.
question: Can the unchanged, verified V1R2 collector produce the ten approved AEE development trajectories under a valid authorization evidence record?

stop_conditions: Any authorization, interpreter, image, planner, world, zstd, frozen-tool, parent-seal or contract drift.
Any startup/topic/type/synchronization/count/range/off-ring/distance/ownership/archive/disk/evidence failure; stop and seal without retry.
Any partial-asset reuse, pre-existing output overwrite, teacher/model/training/C09/C10/strict-test access.
